items.finding: Marriage passage foregrounds cross-luminary trine/sextile; friendship passage distinguishes co-sign/exchange from weaker aspect-only affiliations and adds Fortune/ASC bases. Different inquiries, not two votes from one geometry.
The same five-planet pair names occur in character profiles and temporary cross-nativity encounters; context/topical selection and directed motion differ. One lookup cannot replace the other.

items.topic: Mercury signification changes with inherited context
items.finding: Added to favorable Jupiter-Venus rulers, Mercury often adds gain/gifts/honor; in the adverse sequence he adds distinct hazards. Do not average into a universal Mercury travel score.
Explicit cross-reference carries mixture/dominance into favorable and adverse travel branches. It is not optional merely because a simple clause sounds categorical.
